abing.note_zh: 原名华彦钧，以二胡曲《二泉映月》闻名。
abing.note_en: The musician Hua Yanjun, remembered especially for the erhu piece Moon Reflected on the Second Spring.

anyang.note_zh: 河南北部的城市，殷墟和许多甲骨文在这里发现。
anyang.note_en: A city in northern Henan where the Shang ruins and many oracle bones were found.

analects.note_zh: 记录孔子及其弟子言论和问答的一部古代文集。
analects.note_en: An ancient collection of sayings and conversations connected with Confucius and his students.

bai-suzhen.note_zh: 《白蛇传》中由白蛇化成的女子。
bai-suzhen.note_en: The woman who takes human form from a white snake in the Legend of the White Snake.

bianzhong.note_zh: 成组悬挂、按音高排列演奏的古代青铜钟。
bianzhong.note_en: A tuned set of ancient Chinese bronze bells hung on a frame.

biluochun.note_zh: 产自苏州太湖一带、叶片卷曲的著名绿茶。
biluochun.note_en: A famous curled green tea from the Lake Tai area near Suzhou.

bo-ya.note_zh: 古代知音故事中善于弹琴的人。
bo-ya.note_en: The gifted qin player in the old Chinese story about a friend who truly understood his music.

book-of-changes.note_zh: 中国古代讨论卦象、变化和思想的一部经典，又称《周易》。
book-of-changes.note_en: An ancient Chinese classic about patterns, change, and interpretation, also called the Yijing.

book-of-songs.note_zh: 中国现存最早的诗歌总集，收录了三百多首古代诗歌。
book-of-songs.note_en: The oldest surviving collection of Chinese poetry, containing more than three hundred poems.

cao-cao.note_zh: 东汉末年的政治家、军事家和诗人。
cao-cao.note_en: A powerful leader, commander, and poet at the end of the Eastern Han dynasty.

cao-xueqin.note_en: The author of Dream of the Red Chamber.

chang-e.note_zh: 中国神话中飞到月亮上的人物。
chang-e.note_en: The woman who flies to the moon in a famous Chinese legend.

changan.note_zh: 中国古代都城，位置在今天的西安。
changan.note_en: An ancient Chinese capital located in present-day Xi'an.

chengqi-building.note_zh: 福建永定一座规模很大的圆形土楼。
chengqi-building.note_en: A very large round tulou in Yongding, Fujian.

chinese-calligraphy.note_zh: 用毛笔等工具书写汉字的艺术。
chinese-calligraphy.note_en: The art of writing Chinese characters with expressive brushwork.

chinese-knot.note_zh: 用一根或多根绳子编成的装饰结。
chinese-knot.note_en: A decorative knot made by looping and tightening cord into a balanced pattern.

confucius.note_zh: 生活在两千五百多年前、在鲁国教学生的中国思想家和老师。
confucius.note_en: A Chinese thinker and teacher who lived more than 2,500 years ago and taught in the state of Lu.

cuju.note_zh: 中国古代用脚踢球的一类游戏。
cuju.note_en: An ancient Chinese family of ball games played mainly with the feet.

dao.note_zh: 道家思想中万物运行所遵循的自然之道。
dao.note_en: The natural Way or underlying pattern of the world in Daoist thought.

dao-de-jing.note_zh: 与老子和早期道家思想关系密切的经典。
dao-de-jing.note_en: A short classic linked with Laozi and early Daoist thought.

dragon-boat-festival.note_zh: 农历五月初五的传统节日。
dragon-boat-festival.note_en: A traditional festival held on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.

dunhuang.note_zh: 中国西北以石窟壁画闻名的城市。
dunhuang.note_en: A northwestern Chinese city famous for its painted cave temples.

eight-immortals.note_zh: 中国道教故事中性格和法宝各不相同的八位仙人。
eight-immortals.note_en: A famous group of eight Daoist immortals, each with a different personality and special object.

erhu.note_zh: 有两根弦、用弓拉奏的中国乐器。

erquan-yingyue.en: Moon Reflected on the Second Spring
erquan-yingyue.note_zh: 阿炳创作并演奏的一首著名二胡曲。
erquan-yingyue.note_en: A famous erhu composition associated with Abing.

fahai.note_zh: 《白蛇传》中阻止白素贞和许仙团聚的和尚。
fahai.note_en: The monk who separates Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian in the Legend of the White Snake.

fenghuang.note_zh: 中国传统文化中的吉祥神鸟。
fenghuang.note_en: The auspicious legendary bird often called the Chinese phoenix.

forbidden-city.note_zh: 北京明清两代的皇宫建筑群。
forbidden-city.note_en: The enormous imperial palace complex in Beijing used during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

futou.note_zh: 中国古代男子使用的一类头巾和帽式。
futou.note_en: A form of men's headwear used in imperial China.

gongbi.note_zh: 用细致线条和层层设色完成的中国画法。
gongbi.note_en: A detailed Chinese painting style built with precise lines and carefully layered color.

court-painting-academy.note_zh: 朝廷设立、由宫廷画师工作的绘画机构。
court-painting-academy.note_en: An imperial institution where court painters worked and trained.

lacquer.note_zh: 一种可以涂在物体表面、干后变硬并产生光泽的材料。
lacquer.note_en: A coating material that hardens and can form a glossy surface.

song-huizong.note_zh: 北宋皇帝赵佶，擅长书画，也很重视宫廷画院。
song-huizong.note_en: A Northern Song emperor known for painting, calligraphy, and support of the court painting academy.

gongfu.note_zh: 既可以指武术，也可以指长期练习形成的本领。
gongfu.note_en: A word that can mean martial arts or any skill developed through long practice.

gongshou-li.note_zh: 双手在身前相合的一种传统问候礼节。
gongshou-li.note_en: A traditional greeting made by bringing both hands together in front of the body.

guan-yu.note_zh: 三国时期的将领，后来成为忠义的著名象征。
guan-yu.note_en: A Three Kingdoms general later remembered as a powerful symbol of loyalty.

guanyin.note_zh: 中国佛教中以慈悲、救助众生闻名的菩萨。
guanyin.note_en: A compassionate bodhisattva who hears and helps beings in distress.

guilin.note_zh: 中国南方以喀斯特山水闻名的城市。
guilin.note_en: A southern Chinese city famous for its karst peaks and river scenery.

han-dynasty.note_zh: 从公元前206年延续到公元220年的中国重要朝代。
han-dynasty.note_en: A major Chinese dynasty that lasted from 206 BCE to 220 CE.

hanfu.note_zh: 中国历史上汉族服饰传统的统称。
hanfu.note_en: A broad modern name for historical Han Chinese clothing traditions.

hangzhou.note_zh: 浙江省省会，西湖和龙井茶都与这里关系密切。
hangzhou.note_en: The capital of Zhejiang, closely associated with West Lake and Dragon Well tea.

hongbao.note_zh: 节日或喜庆场合装钱赠送的红色封套。
hongbao.note_en: A red packet containing money, given during festivals and happy occasions.

honghe-hani-terraces.note_zh: 云南南部哈尼族长期修建和维护的山地梯田。
honghe-hani-terraces.note_en: Mountain terraces in southern Yunnan built and maintained by Hani communities.

hou-yi.note_zh: 神话中射下九个太阳的神射手。
hou-yi.note_en: The legendary archer who shoots down nine suns.

huadian.note_zh: 古代女子贴或画在额头、眉心的小装饰。
huadian.note_en: A small painted or applied decoration worn on the forehead.

huoyao.note_zh: 由含硝石、硫黄和炭的混合物发展而来的火药技术。
huoyao.note_en: The explosive mixture whose Chinese name literally means fire medicine.

jia-baoyu.note_en: One of the central young characters in Dream of the Red Chamber.

jiaguwen.note_zh: 刻在龟甲和兽骨上的商代文字。
jiaguwen.note_en: Shang-period writing carved on turtle shells and animal bones.

jiangnan.note_zh: 长江下游以南、河湖密布的地区。
jiangnan.note_en: The warm, watery region south of the lower Yangtze River.

jiaozi-currency.note_zh: 北宋四川出现并由政府发行的早期纸币。
jiaozi-currency.note_en: An early paper currency used in Sichuan and later issued by the Northern Song government.

jingdezhen.note_zh: 中国最有名的瓷器城市之一。
jingdezhen.note_en: A Chinese city famous for porcelain production.

jingju.note_zh: 结合唱、念、做、打的中国戏曲形式。
jingju.note_en: A form of Chinese opera combining song, speech, movement, and stylized combat.

jingwei.note_zh: 神话中不停衔石填海的小鸟。
jingwei.note_en: The little mythic bird that keeps carrying stones and twigs to fill the sea.

kaifeng.note_zh: 北宋的都城，也是一座商业繁盛的城市。
kaifeng.note_en: The Northern Song capital, famous for its busy streets and markets.

keju.note_zh: 中国古代通过考试选拔官员的制度。
keju.note_en: The examination system used in imperial China to select officials.

kuang-heng.note_zh: 凿壁借光故事中的读书人。
kuang-heng.note_en: The student associated with the story of borrowing light through a hole in the wall.

laozi.note_zh: 与《道德经》和早期道家思想密切相关的古代思想家。
laozi.note_en: The ancient thinker linked with the Dao De Jing and early Daoist ideas.

li-bai.note_zh: 唐代诗人，以豪放的想象和月亮、旅行等题材闻名。
li-bai.note_en: A Tang poet known for bold imagination, moonlight, and travel.

li-distance.note_zh: 中国古代使用的长度单位，不同时期的实际长度并不完全相同。
li-distance.note_en: An old Chinese unit of distance whose exact length varied across time.

li-river.note_zh: 流经桂林和阳朔喀斯特山峰之间的河流。
li-river.note_en: The river that winds among the karst peaks near Guilin and Yangshuo.

li-shizhen.note_zh: 明代医药学家，《本草纲目》的作者。
li-shizhen.note_en: The Ming medical scholar who compiled the Bencao Gangmu.

liu-bei.note_zh: 三国时期蜀汉的建立者。
liu-bei.note_en: The founder of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period.

longjing.note_zh: 杭州西湖一带以扁平叶形闻名的绿茶。
longjing.note_en: The flat-leaf green tea closely associated with West Lake in Hangzhou.

lu-ban.note_zh: 中国传统故事中著名的木匠和工匠祖师。
lu-ban.note_en: The legendary master carpenter and patron of craftspeople.

lu-dongbin.note_zh: 八仙之一，常被画成背剑的文士。
lu-dongbin.note_en: One of the Eight Immortals, often shown as a scholar carrying a sword.

luoyang.note_zh: 中国古都，白马寺位于这里。
luoyang.note_en: An ancient Chinese capital and the home of White Horse Temple.

mahjong.note_zh: 使用牌张组合成牌型的中国传统游戏。
mahjong.note_en: A Chinese game in which players draw and discard tiles to build combinations.

maitreya.note_zh: 佛教中的未来佛，在中国常和笑口常开的布袋和尚形象联系起来。
maitreya.note_en: The future Buddha, often connected in China with the smiling Cloth-Bag Monk.

meng-yuanlao.note_zh: 记录北宋开封城市生活的《东京梦华录》作者。
meng-yuanlao.note_en: The writer who remembered Northern Song Kaifeng in the Dongjing Meng Hua Lu.

mid-autumn-festival.note_zh: 农历八月十五赏月团聚的传统节日。
mid-autumn-festival.note_en: The traditional festival of family reunion and moon viewing on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.

ming-dynasty.note_en: The Chinese dynasty that lasted from 1368 to 1644.

mingguang-armor.note_zh: 名字与胸前明亮护片有关的一类古代铠甲。
mingguang-armor.note_en: A type of ancient armor named for the bright plates on its chest.

mozi.note_zh: 战国时期思想家，古书把木鸟故事与他联系起来。
mozi.note_en: A Warring States thinker associated in old texts with a story about a wooden bird.

mulan.note_en: The young woman in the Ballad of Mulan who joins the army in her father's place.

nantong.note_zh: 江苏的城市，以精巧的板鹞风筝闻名。
nantong.note_en: A city in Jiangsu known for elaborate banyao kites.

nuwa.note_zh: 中国神话中炼石补天的女神。
nuwa.note_en: The goddess in Chinese myth who repairs the broken sky.

porcelain.note_zh: 用瓷土等材料高温烧成的坚硬陶瓷制品。
porcelain.note_en: A hard, high-fired ceramic material made from carefully prepared clay.

qin-shi-huang.note_zh: 建立秦朝、统一中国的第一位皇帝。
qin-shi-huang.note_en: The First Emperor, who founded the Qin dynasty and united China.

qing-dynasty.note_zh: 1644年至1912年的中国最后一个帝制王朝。
qing-dynasty.note_en: China's last imperial dynasty, lasting from 1644 to 1912.

qinglong-yanyuedao.note_zh: 《三国演义》和后世艺术中与关羽联系在一起的长柄大刀。
qinglong-yanyuedao.note_en: The great curved blade paired with Guan Yu in the novel and later art.

qingming.note_zh: 春天祭扫祖先、也会踏青的传统节日。
qingming.note_en: A spring festival associated with visiting ancestors' graves and enjoying the outdoors.

qu-yuan.note_zh: 战国时期楚国诗人，后来许多端午故事都与他联系起来。
qu-yuan.note_en: A poet of the state of Chu later connected with many Dragon Boat Festival stories.

quanfa.note_zh: 以出拳、掌法、步法和身体动作进行攻防的武术技法。
quanfa.note_en: Chinese martial-arts techniques using punches, open-hand movements, footwork, and body control.

red-chamber.note_zh: 讲述贾府兴衰和一群年轻人生活的古典小说。
red-chamber.note_en: A classic novel about the Jia household and the young people growing up within it.

rice-terraces.note_zh: 沿山坡一层层开出的水田。
rice-terraces.note_en: Stepped fields built across mountain slopes to hold soil and water.

ruyi-jingu-bang.note_zh: 《西游记》中孙悟空能够随意变大变小的兵器。
ruyi-jingu-bang.note_en: Sun Wukong's magic staff, which can grow, shrink, and change weight.

shan-hai-jing.note_zh: 记录古代山川、物产、神话人物和奇异动物的古书。
shan-hai-jing.note_en: An ancient book filled with mountains, places, gods, and strange creatures.

shang-yang.note_zh: 战国时期在秦国推行变法的政治家。
shang-yang.note_en: The Warring States reformer who changed laws and government in Qin.

shanghai.note_zh: 中国东部沿海的大城市。
shanghai.note_en: A major city on China's eastern coast.

shaolin-temple.note_zh: 河南嵩山附近以佛教和武术传统闻名的寺院。
shaolin-temple.note_en: A Buddhist monastery near Mount Song, famous for its martial-arts tradition.

shen-kuo.note_zh: 北宋学者，《梦溪笔谈》的作者。
shen-kuo.note_en: A Northern Song scholar and the author of the Dream Pool Essays.

shengxiao.note_zh: 用十二种动物依次表示出生年份的传统系统。
shengxiao.note_en: The twelve-animal cycle traditionally connected with years of birth.

shu.note_zh: 从自己的感受出发，想到别人，并不把自己不愿承受的事情加给别人。
shu.note_en: Beginning with your own experience, considering another person, and not imposing on others what you would reject for yourself.

silk-road.note_zh: 连接中国、中亚和更远地区的多条古代交通与贸易路线。
silk-road.note_en: A network of old routes linking China, Central Asia, and lands farther west.

song-ci.note_zh: 按照曲调格式填写、在宋代特别兴盛的文学形式。
song-ci.note_en: Song-dynasty lyrics written to established musical tune patterns.

song-dynasty.note_zh: 中国历史上从960年延续到1279年的朝代。
song-dynasty.note_en: The Chinese dynasty that lasted from 960 to 1279.

staff-fighting.note_zh: 使用长棍进行格挡、进攻和控制的武术技法。
staff-fighting.note_en: Martial-arts techniques for controlling and using a long staff to block, strike, and redirect.

state-of-lu.note_zh: 周代的一个诸侯国，大致位于今天的山东一带，与孔子的生平密切相关。
state-of-lu.note_en: An ancient state centered in what is now Shandong and closely connected with Confucius.

su-shi.note_zh: 宋代文学家和诗人，又叫苏东坡。
su-shi.note_en: A Song writer and poet also known as Su Dongpo.

sun-wukong.note_zh: 《西游记》中会七十二变、保护唐僧西行的美猴王。
sun-wukong.note_en: The Monkey King of Journey to the West, famous for magic transformations and his staff.

suzhou.note_zh: 江苏的城市，以园林、运河和传统工艺闻名。
suzhou.note_en: A city in Jiangsu famous for gardens, canals, and traditional crafts.

suanpan.note_zh: 用算珠在档杆上移动进行计算的工具。
suanpan.note_en: A calculating tool whose beads slide along rods toward or away from a central beam.

taiji-diagram.note_zh: 后来用来表现阴阳相连、相互变化关系的圆形图案。
taiji-diagram.note_en: A later circular diagram used to show yin and yang as connected and changing.

taijiquan.note_zh: 重视缓慢连贯动作、呼吸和身体控制的中国武术。
taijiquan.note_en: A Chinese martial art known for slow connected movement, breathing, and control.

tang-dynasty.note_en: The Chinese dynasty that lasted from 618 to 907.

tang-poetry.note_zh: 唐代创作并流传下来的诗歌。
tang-poetry.note_en: Poetry written during the Tang dynasty.

tea-horse-roads.note_zh: 把中国西南茶区与青藏高原连接起来的多条旧交通路线。
tea-horse-roads.note_en: Old routes that carried tea between southwestern China and the Tibetan Plateau.

temple-of-heaven.note_zh: 北京供明清皇帝祭天祈谷的建筑群。
temple-of-heaven.note_en: The Beijing complex where Ming and Qing emperors held ceremonies for Heaven.

terracotta.note_zh: 经过塑形和烧制后变硬的陶土材料。
terracotta.note_en: Clay that is shaped and baked until it becomes hard.

terracotta-warriors.note_zh: 秦始皇陵附近出土的大型陶制军阵。
terracotta-warriors.note_en: The life-size clay army found near the tomb of the First Emperor.

tieguai-li.note_zh: 八仙之一，常带铁拐和大葫芦。
tieguai-li.note_en: One of the Eight Immortals, recognized by his iron crutch and large gourd.

tulou.note_zh: 中国东南一些地区以夯土建造、供许多家庭共同居住的大型建筑。
tulou.note_en: A large rammed-earth building in southeastern China designed for many households.

wang-xizhi.note_en: A celebrated calligrapher of the Eastern Jin period.

water-margin.note_zh: 讲述梁山好汉聚义的古典小说。
water-margin.note_en: The classic novel about the outlaws who gather at Liangshan.

weiqi.note_zh: 双方轮流在棋盘交叉点放置黑白棋子的棋类游戏。
weiqi.note_en: The strategy game in which two players place black and white stones on a grid.

white-horse-temple.note_zh: 洛阳著名古寺，常与佛教早期传入中国的故事联系起来。
white-horse-temple.note_en: A famous temple in Luoyang associated with stories of Buddhism's early arrival in China.

wu-zetian.note_zh: 中国历史上唯一正式称帝的女性。
wu-zetian.note_en: The only woman in Chinese history to rule with the formal title of emperor.

xian.note_zh: 中国著名古都，古代长安所在地。
xian.note_en: A major historic city and the modern location of ancient Chang'an.

xiaoqing.note_zh: 《白蛇传》中白素贞的伙伴，由青蛇化成人形。
xiaoqing.note_en: Bai Suzhen's companion in the Legend of the White Snake, transformed from a green snake.

xiongnu.note_zh: 古代生活在中国北方草原及其周边的强大游牧联盟。
xiongnu.note_en: A powerful confederation based in the northern grasslands in ancient times.

xuanzang.note_zh: 唐代前往印度求取佛经的僧人。
xuanzang.note_en: The Tang monk who traveled to India to study Buddhism and bring back scriptures.

xu-xian.note_zh: 《白蛇传》中在西湖边遇见白素贞的男子。
xu-xian.note_en: The young man who meets Bai Suzhen beside West Lake in the Legend of the White Snake.

yangshuo.note_zh: 桂林以南、漓江边被群山环绕的小城。
yangshuo.note_en: A riverside town south of Guilin surrounded by karst peaks.

yellow-river.note_zh: 流经中国北方、携带大量泥沙的大河。
yellow-river.note_en: The great northern Chinese river known for carrying large amounts of silt.

yin-yang.note_zh: 用来理解相反、相连而又不断变化的关系的一组概念。
yin-yang.note_en: A paired idea for understanding contrasts that remain connected and change over time.

yu-the-great.note_zh: 中国古代传说中治理洪水的英雄。
yu-the-great.note_en: The legendary hero who controls a great flood.

yunnan.note_zh: 中国西南部山地众多、民族文化丰富的省份。
yunnan.note_en: A mountainous province in southwestern China with many cultural communities.

zhang-qian.note_zh: 汉代出使西域、带回中亚信息的使者。
zhang-qian.note_en: The Han envoy whose difficult journeys brought the court new information about Central Asia.

zhaozhou-bridge.note_zh: 隋代工匠李春主持建造的著名石拱桥。
zhaozhou-bridge.note_en: The famous Sui stone arch bridge traditionally credited to the builder Li Chun.

zheng-he.note_zh: 明代率领船队七次远航的航海家。
zheng-he.note_en: The Ming admiral who led seven great voyages across the Indian Ocean.

zhong-ziqi.note_zh: 伯牙知音故事中真正听懂琴声的人。
zhong-ziqi.note_en: The listener in the Bo Ya story who truly understood the music.

zhu-bajie.note_zh: 《西游记》中使用九齿钉耙的取经人之一。
zhu-bajie.note_en: One of the Journey to the West pilgrims, recognized by his pig face and rake.

zhu-yuanzhang.note_en: The founding emperor of the Ming dynasty.

anhui.note_zh: 中国东部的一个省，朱元璋出生在今天安徽凤阳一带。
anhui.note_en: A province in eastern China; Zhu Yuanzhang was born in the area of present-day Fengyang, Anhui.

yuan-dynasty.note_en: The Chinese dynasty that lasted from 1271 to 1368.

memorial.note_zh: 官员送往朝廷或皇帝的正式报告、请求或建议。
memorial.note_en: An official report, request, or proposal sent toward the court or emperor.

central-secretariat.note_zh: 明初协调中央政务、统领六部的重要机构，1380年被撤销。
central-secretariat.note_en: A major early Ming administrative office abolished by Zhu Yuanzhang in 1380.

chancellor.note_zh: 辅佐皇帝、统领许多中央政务的重要官职。
chancellor.note_en: A powerful official who helped coordinate the central government.

ministry-of-personnel.note_zh: 管理官员的选拔、任免、考核和升降。
ministry-of-personnel.note_en: The ministry responsible for selecting, appointing, evaluating, and promoting officials.

ministry-of-revenue.note_zh: 管理户籍、土地、税收和国家钱粮。
ministry-of-revenue.note_en: The ministry responsible for population records, land, taxes, and state revenue.

ministry-of-rites.note_zh: 管理国家礼仪、祭祀、学校、科举和外事接待。
ministry-of-rites.note_en: The ministry responsible for state ceremonies, rituals, education, examinations, and diplomatic receptions.

ministry-of-war.note_zh: 管理武官选任、军籍和军令等军事行政。
ministry-of-war.note_en: The ministry responsible for military appointments, army records, orders, and administration.

ministry-of-justice.note_en: The ministry responsible for laws, trials, and criminal punishments.

ministry-of-works.note_zh: 管理建筑、道路、水利和各种大型工程。
ministry-of-works.note_en: The ministry responsible for construction, roads, waterworks, and other major public projects.

six-ministries.note_zh: 吏部管官员，户部管钱粮户籍，礼部管礼仪科举，兵部管军事行政，刑部管法律刑罚，工部管工程。
six-ministries.note_en: The six central departments responsible for officials, revenue, rites, war, justice, and public works.

hu-weiyong.note_zh: 明初丞相；1380年胡惟庸案后，朱元璋撤销中书省和丞相。
hu-weiyong.note_en: An early Ming chancellor whose 1380 case preceded Zhu Yuanzhang's abolition of the office.

zhuge-liang.note_zh: 三国时期蜀汉的政治家和军事家，后世以足智多谋闻名。
zhuge-liang.note_en: The Shu Han statesman and strategist later remembered for extraordinary cleverness.

bai-juyi.note_zh: 唐代诗人，写过许多语言明白、感情真切的诗。
bai-juyi.note_en: A Tang poet known for clear, direct poems about both everyday life and public affairs.

bimawen.note_zh: 《西游记》中天庭给孙悟空安排的养马官职。
bimawen.note_en: The low-ranking heavenly stable post given to Sun Wukong in Journey to the West.

cai-lun.note_zh: 东汉官员，因改进并推广造纸方法而闻名。
cai-lun.note_en: An Eastern Han official remembered for improving and reporting papermaking methods.

cai-you.note_zh: 北朝将领，因穿着明光铠作战而被敌军称为“铁猛兽”。
cai-you.note_en: A Northern Dynasties general whose bright armor helped earn him the nickname Iron Beast.

chai-wangye.note_zh: 八仙故事中曹国舅在一些民间版本里的旧称。
chai-wangye.note_en: An older folk-story name associated in some versions with Cao Guojiu of the Eight Immortals.

du-fu.note_zh: 唐代诗人，许多诗记录了战乱和普通人的生活。
du-fu.note_en: A Tang poet whose work records war, hardship, family, and everyday life.

erlang-shen.note_zh: 中国神话中的神将，《西游记》中曾与孙悟空交战。
erlang-shen.note_en: A warrior deity who battles Sun Wukong in Journey to the West.

fu-hao.note_zh: 商王武丁的妻子，也是一位领兵将领。
fu-hao.note_en: A wife of the Shang king Wu Ding who also led military campaigns.

great-sage-equal-heaven.note_zh: 孙悟空不满天庭官职后给自己取的称号。
great-sage-equal-heaven.note_en: The grand title Sun Wukong gives himself after rejecting Heaven's low-ranking job.

huang-gai.note_zh: 三国时期东吴将领，赤壁之战中率火船冲向曹军。
huang-gai.note_en: The Eastern Wu commander who led fire ships toward Cao Cao's fleet at Red Cliffs.

jade-emperor.note_zh: 中国民间信仰和道教故事中统领天庭的神。
jade-emperor.note_en: The ruler of Heaven in many Chinese folk and Daoist stories.

journey-to-the-west.note_zh: 讲述唐僧师徒西行取经和一路奇遇的古典小说。
journey-to-the-west.note_en: The classic novel about a scripture journey west with the Monkey King and his companions.

li-chun.note_zh: 隋代主持建造赵州桥的工匠。
li-chun.note_en: The Sui-era builder traditionally credited with designing Zhaozhou Bridge.

li-qingzhao.note_en: A celebrated Song dynasty poet especially known for ci poetry.

li-shimin.note_zh: 唐朝第二位皇帝唐太宗，登基前曾率军作战。
li-shimin.note_en: The future Emperor Taizong, second emperor of the Tang dynasty and a military commander before taking the throne.

miluo-river.note_zh: 湖南的一条河，与屈原的故事和端午习俗相连。
miluo-river.note_en: A river in Hunan linked with the story of Qu Yuan and Dragon Boat Festival traditions.

rammed-earth.note_zh: 把湿润的泥土分层放入模板，再反复夯实形成的建筑材料。
rammed-earth.note_en: Earth packed firmly in layers inside a frame to make strong walls.

shandong.note_en: A coastal province in eastern China.

shanxi.note_zh: 中国北部省份，保存着许多重要古建筑。
shanxi.note_en: A northern Chinese province with many important historic buildings.

sha-wujing.note_zh: 《西游记》中保护唐僧西行的徒弟之一，也常被叫作沙僧。
sha-wujing.note_en: One of the Journey to the West pilgrims, also commonly called Sandy or Monk Sha.

taishang-laojun.note_zh: 道教尊神，《西游记》中掌管炼丹炉和仙丹。
taishang-laojun.note_en: A high Daoist deity who keeps the alchemy furnace and magical pills in Journey to the West.

tang-monk.note_zh: 《西游记》中带领徒弟西行取经的僧人。
tang-monk.note_en: The scripture-seeking monk protected by Sun Wukong and the other pilgrims in Journey to the West.

taihu.note_zh: 位于江南的大型淡水湖，苏州和无锡都在湖边。
taihu.note_en: A large freshwater lake in Jiangnan, bordered by cities including Suzhou and Wuxi.

white-bone-demon.note_zh: 《西游记》中多次变成人形欺骗唐僧的妖怪。
white-bone-demon.note_en: A demon who repeatedly disguises herself as a human to deceive the Tang Monk.

wu-ding.note_zh: 商代国王，安阳甲骨文中保存了许多与他有关的记录。
wu-ding.note_en: A Shang king whose questions and decisions appear in many oracle-bone inscriptions.

wukong-short.note_en: The shortened form of Sun Wukong's name.

yingxian.note_zh: 山西北部的县，以应县木塔闻名。
yingxian.note_en: A county in northern Shanxi famous for its tall wooden pagoda.

west-lake.note_zh: 杭州著名的湖泊，也是许多传说和诗画的背景。
west-lake.note_en: The famous lake in Hangzhou that appears in many poems, paintings, and legends.

yan-liang.note_zh: 东汉末年将领，史书记载关羽在战阵中击败了他。
yan-liang.note_en: A late Han commander defeated by Guan Yu in an early historical account.

zhou-yu.note_zh: 东吴将领，赤壁之战中统领吴军。
zhou-yu.note_en: The Eastern Wu commander who directed Wu forces at the Battle of Red Cliffs.

buyao.note_zh: 插在发髻上的垂饰，走路时会轻轻摇动。
buyao.note_en: A hair ornament with hanging pieces that move as the wearer walks.

cao-zhi.note_zh: 三国时期诗人，也是曹操的儿子。
cao-zhi.note_en: A Three Kingdoms poet and a son of Cao Cao.

circular-mound-altar.note_zh: 天坛内用于冬至祭天的露天圆形石坛。
circular-mound-altar.note_en: The open-air circular stone altar at the Temple of Heaven used for the winter-solstice ceremony.

great-cien-temple.note_zh: 西安大雁塔所在的佛教寺院。
great-cien-temple.note_en: The Buddhist temple in Xi'an where the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda was built.

hani.note_zh: 中国西南地区的民族之一，红河哈尼梯田由当地社区长期营造和维护。
hani.note_en: An ethnic group in southwestern China whose communities have long cared for the Honghe rice terraces.

jiaoling-youren.en: crossed collar closing to the right
jiaoling-youren.note_zh: 衣襟交叉、左襟盖住右襟的一种传统穿法。
jiaoling-youren.note_en: A traditional robe construction in which the left front crosses over the right.

liu-sheng.note_zh: 西汉中山靖王，他的墓中出土了重要文物。
liu-sheng.note_en: A Western Han prince whose tomb contained important archaeological finds.

penglai.note_zh: 山东沿海城市，古港遗址出土过木船。
penglai.note_en: A coastal place in Shandong where wooden ships were excavated from an old harbor.

relics.note_zh: 佛陀或受敬重僧人留下、被人珍重保存的遗骨、骨灰或物品。
relics.note_en: Ashes, bone fragments, or objects associated with the Buddha or a respected monk.

shuixiu.note_zh: 戏曲服装袖口接出的长白绸，演员用它表现动作和情绪。
shuixiu.note_en: Long white silk extensions on opera sleeves, moved by performers to express action and emotion.

sui-dynasty.note_zh: 581年至618年的朝代，结束长期分裂并为唐朝奠定基础。
sui-dynasty.note_en: The short dynasty from 581 to 618 that reunified China before the Tang.

sunzi.note_zh: 传统上被认为与《孙子兵法》有关的古代军事思想家。
sunzi.note_en: The ancient strategist traditionally associated with The Art of War.

xiao-river.note_zh: 河北的一条河，赵州桥横跨其上。
xiao-river.note_en: The river in Hebei crossed by Zhaozhou Bridge.

yiji.note_zh: 加在真发上的假发髻，可用头发、麻布或薄木等材料制成。
yiji.note_en: An added hair bun made from materials such as hair, cloth, or thin wood.

yinqueshan.note_zh: 山东临沂的汉墓遗址，出土了《孙子兵法》等竹简。
yinqueshan.note_en: A Han tomb site in Shandong where bamboo-strip texts including The Art of War were found.

zhang-guolao.note_zh: 八仙之一，民间故事里常倒骑毛驴。
zhang-guolao.note_en: One of the Eight Immortals, often shown riding a donkey backward.

zhaozhou-place.note_zh: 赵州桥所在地过去使用的地名。
zhaozhou-place.note_en: The historical place name that gave Zhaozhou Bridge its name.

banliang.note_zh: 秦统一后推行的圆形方孔铜钱。
banliang.note_en: The round bronze coin with a square hole standardized under the Qin empire.

banyao-kite.note_zh: 南通一带著名的板形风筝，常装有竹制或葫芦制的哨子。
banyao-kite.note_en: A flat Nantong kite that can carry bamboo or gourd whistles.

chu-state.note_zh: 战国时期的重要诸侯国之一。
chu-state.note_en: One of the major states of ancient China during the Warring States period.

erlang-short.note_en: A shortened form of Erlang Shen's name.

jiazi.note_zh: 干支纪年六十种组合中的第一种，也可以指一个六十年周期。
jiazi.note_en: The first pairing in the sixty-year stem-and-branch cycle, and a name for the full cycle.

jianzhǐ.note_zh: 用剪刀或刻刀在纸上制作图案的传统艺术。
jianzhǐ.note_en: The traditional art of cutting or carving patterns from paper.

jingjiao.note_zh: 唐代中国对东方教会基督教传统的一种称呼。
jingjiao.note_en: A Tang Chinese name for the Church of the East Christian tradition.

madiao.note_zh: 明代流行的一类长条纸牌游戏。
madiao.note_en: A family of long, narrow paper-card games popular in Ming China.

qingtuan.note_zh: 清明前后常见的绿色糯米点心。
qingtuan.note_en: A green glutinous-rice treat often eaten around Qingming.

taqing.note_zh: 春天到郊外散步、游玩的传统活动。
taqing.note_en: A spring outing or walk outdoors to enjoy the new season.

yasuiqian.note_zh: 过年时长辈给孩子的钱，寄托平安和祝福。
yasuiqian.note_en: New Year money given to children with wishes for safety and good fortune.

zhusuan.note_zh: 使用算盘和口诀进行计算的中国传统计算方法。
zhusuan.note_en: The Chinese tradition of calculating with an abacus and memorized oral formulas.

zongzi.note_zh: 用叶子包裹糯米和馅料后煮熟的传统食物。
zongzi.note_en: A traditional food of glutinous rice and fillings wrapped in leaves and cooked.

chengdu.note_zh: 四川省省会，也是重要的大熊猫保护和研究中心。
chengdu.note_en: The capital of Sichuan and an important center for giant-panda conservation and research.

chopsticks.note_zh: 成对使用、用来夹取食物的细长餐具。
chopsticks.note_en: A pair of slender eating utensils used together to lift food.

cowherd.note_zh: 牛郎织女传说中在人间放牛的年轻人。
cowherd.note_en: The young herder in the Cowherd and Weaver Girl legend.

ink-wash-painting.note_zh: 主要用墨和水的浓淡变化作画的中国画传统。
ink-wash-painting.note_en: A Chinese painting tradition that builds images through varied mixtures of ink and water.

king-min-qi.note_zh: 战国时期齐国国君，故事里喜欢听乐师独奏。
king-min-qi.note_en: A ruler of Qi who, in the story, wanted to hear each musician play alone.

jiang-ziya.note_zh: 商周之际的重要人物，又称吕尚、姜太公，后来辅佐周文王。
jiang-ziya.note_en: An important figure near the end of the Shang period, also known as Lü Shang and Jiang Taigong, who later advised King Wen of Zhou.

king-wen-zhou.note_zh: 周朝建立前的重要领袖，传说中发现并重用姜子牙的人。
king-wen-zhou.note_en: A major leader before the Zhou dynasty was founded who, in the story, recognizes Jiang Ziya’s ability.

king-xuan-qi.note_zh: 战国时期齐国国君，故事里喜欢听许多乐师合奏。
king-xuan-qi.note_en: A ruler of Qi who, in the story, enjoyed hearing a large ensemble play together.

nanguo.note_zh: 滥竽充数故事中不会吹竽却混进乐队的人。
nanguo.note_en: The man in the story who joins the orchestra even though he cannot play the yu.

nian-monster.note_zh: 春节民间故事中害怕红色、火光和响声的怪兽。
nian-monster.note_en: The New Year monster in a folk tale that fears red, firelight, and loud noises.

qixi.note_zh: 农历七月初七的传统节日，与牛郎织女传说相连。
qixi.note_en: The traditional festival on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month, linked with the Cowherd and Weaver Girl.

qomolangma.note_zh: 位于中国与尼泊尔边界、海拔世界最高的山峰，英语常称 Mount Everest。
qomolangma.note_en: The world's highest peak above sea level, called Mount Everest in English.

queen-mother-west.note_zh: 中国神话中的重要女神，在牛郎织女故事中把两人隔在天河两边。
queen-mother-west.note_en: A powerful goddess who separates the Cowherd and Weaver Girl in the legend.

bamboo-slips.note_zh: 把文字写在竹片上，再用绳子编联起来的古代书写材料。
bamboo-slips.note_en: Narrow bamboo strips written on and tied together as an ancient writing material.

book-of-rites.note_zh: 记载古代礼仪、制度和思想的重要典籍。
book-of-rites.note_en: An important classical work about ancient ritual, institutions, and ideas.

book-of-documents.note_zh: 保存上古政治、传说和治水叙述的重要经典。
book-of-documents.note_en: An ancient classic preserving political traditions and accounts of Yǔ's work with water.

counting-rods.note_zh: 古代用来表示数字和帮助计算的小棍。
counting-rods.note_en: Small rods used to represent numbers and carry out calculations.

guozi.note_zh: 《周礼》中与统治阶层关系密切、接受教育的年轻人。
guozi.note_en: Young people connected with the ruling elite who receive instruction in the Rites of Zhou.

chaju.note_zh: 汉代等时期由地方官考察并向朝廷推荐人才的选官方式。
chaju.note_en: A method in which local officials identified and recommended candidates for government service.

classical-interpretation.note_zh: 科举中根据题目解释儒家经典意义的文章。
classical-interpretation.note_en: Examination writing that explained the meaning of a passage from the Confucian classics.

eight-legged-essay.note_zh: 明清科举中结构严格、讲究对偶的经典论说文。
eight-legged-essay.note_en: A tightly structured examination essay based on the classics and known for balanced parallel sections.

exam-cell.note_zh: 贡院里供考生答题、休息的狭小隔间。
exam-cell.note_en: Narrow compartments in an examination compound where candidates wrote and rested.

exam-top-three.note_zh: 殿试第一甲前三名的称号，状元排在第一。
exam-top-three.note_en: The titles for the top three candidates in the first rank of the palace examination.

gongyuan.note_zh: 古代举行科举考试的专门考场。
gongyuan.note_en: A compound built for holding imperial examinations.

four-books-five-classics.note_zh: 儒家教育与科举学习中长期重视的两组经典。
four-books-five-classics.note_en: Two groups of Confucian classics central to education and examination study in imperial China.

fu.note_zh: 中国古代一种铺陈描写、兼有韵文和散文特点的文体。
fu.note_en: An early Chinese literary form combining expansive description with features of prose and verse.

gun.note_zh: 大禹的父亲，传统故事中先接受治水任务却没有成功。
gun.note_en: Yǔ's father, who is given the flood-control task first but does not succeed in the traditional account.

jinshi.note_zh: 科举最高层级考试中取得的功名，常成为进入仕途的重要起点。
jinshi.note_en: A prestigious degree earned through the highest levels of the imperial examination system.

juren.note_zh: 明清时期通过乡试后获得的功名。
juren.note_en: A degree title earned by passing the provincial examination in the Ming and Qing periods.

metropolitan-examination.note_zh: 明清科举中举人到京城参加的中央一级考试。
metropolitan-examination.note_en: A central examination in the capital taken after the provincial level.

mencius.note_zh: 记录孟子言论与思想的儒家经典，其中保存了大禹三过家门的故事。
mencius.note_en: A Confucian classic that preserves the story of Yǔ passing his doorway three times.

ming-qing-period.note_zh: 从明朝建立到清朝结束的历史时期，大致为1368年至1912年。
ming-qing-period.note_en: The period spanning the Ming and Qing dynasties, from 1368 to 1912.

palace-examination.note_zh: 科举最高一级考试，由皇帝主持名义下决定最终名次。
palace-examination.note_en: The highest examination stage, held under imperial authority to determine final ranking.

policy-response.note_zh: 科举中让考生回答历史或治理问题的写作题。
policy-response.note_en: An examination response discussing a question about history or government policy.

provincial-examination.note_zh: 明清科举中在各省举行的重要考试，考中者称举人。
provincial-examination.note_en: A major Ming and Qing examination held at the provincial level.

qi-of-xia.note_zh: 传统历史中大禹的儿子和夏朝的继任君王。
qi-of-xia.note_en: Yǔ's son and successor as ruler of Xià in traditional history.

records-grand-historian.note_zh: 司马迁撰写的纪传体史书，保存了鲧、禹和夏的传统叙述。
records-grand-historian.note_en: Sima Qian's history, which preserves traditional accounts of Gǔn, Yǔ, and Xià.

shun.note_zh: 中国上古传说中的统治者，传统记载中把治理天下的位置交给禹。
shun.note_en: A legendary early ruler who hands leadership to Yǔ in traditional histories.

wang-anshi.note_zh: 北宋政治家与改革者，在1071年推动科举考试内容改革。
wang-anshi.note_en: A Northern Song statesman and reformer who helped change examination subjects in 1071.

xia-dynasty.note_zh: 传统中国历史中通常被称为第一个王朝，与大禹和启的故事相连。
xia-dynasty.note_en: The dynasty traditionally remembered as China's first and linked with Yǔ and Qǐ.

rites-of-zhou.note_zh: 记述古代官制与礼制理想的经典文献。
rites-of-zhou.note_en: An ancient classical text describing an ideal system of offices, rituals, and education.

shang-zhou-era.note_zh: 商代和周代，战车在战争与贵族生活中都很重要。
shang-zhou-era.note_en: The Shang and Zhou periods, when chariots were important in warfare and elite life.

sui-tang-period.note_zh: 隋朝与唐朝延续的时期，大致为581年至907年。
sui-tang-period.note_en: The period of the Sui and Tang dynasties, lasting from 581 to 907.

sichuan.note_zh: 中国西南省份，拥有大面积的大熊猫山林栖息地。
sichuan.note_en: A southwestern Chinese province containing extensive mountain habitat for giant pandas.

six-arts.note_zh: 古代礼制文献中的教育分类：礼、乐、射、御、书、数。
six-arts.note_en: An ancient educational grouping of ritual, music, archery, chariot driving, writing, and calculation.

weaver-girl.note_zh: 牛郎织女传说中住在天上、擅长织布的女子。
weaver-girl.note_en: The heavenly weaver in the Cowherd and Weaver Girl legend.

ziran.note_zh: 《道德经》中接近“自己如此”的概念，强调事物按照自身情况发展。
ziran.note_en: A Dao De Jing idea close to ‘so of itself’: things becoming according to what they are.

zhu-jun.note_zh: 东汉将领，《三十六计》的按语用他的战事说明声东击西。
zhu-jun.note_en: An Eastern Han commander whose campaign is used to illustrate the stratagem Make Noise Here, Move There.

zigong.note_zh: 孔子的学生，《论语》中记录了他向孔子提出的许多问题。
zigong.note_en: A student of Confucius whose questions appear repeatedly in the Analects.

clerical-script.note_zh: 由早期篆书演变而来、笔画更加平直舒展的古代字体。
clerical-script.note_en: An early script style with flatter, more sweeping strokes than seal script.

cursive-script.note_zh: 笔画常被连写或简化、书写速度很快的书法字体。
cursive-script.note_en: A fast, flowing calligraphic script whose strokes may join or simplify.

regular-script.note_zh: 笔画和结构清楚、今天仍很常见的汉字字体。
regular-script.note_en: A clear, structured Chinese script style still widely used today.

running-script.note_zh: 介于楷书和草书之间、笔势较连贯流动的字体。
running-script.note_en: A flowing script style between the formality of regular script and the speed of cursive.

seal-script.note_zh: 秦代统一文字时使用并规范的一类古老字体。
seal-script.note_en: An ancient script style standardized for official use under the Qin.

dongjing-meng-hua-lu.note_zh: 孟元老回忆北宋开封城市生活的著作。
dongjing-meng-hua-lu.note_en: Meng Yuanlao's vivid account of urban life in Northern Song Kaifeng.

archaeologist.note_zh: 通过遗址和出土物研究过去的人。
archaeologist.note_en: A person who studies the past through sites and objects people left behind.

bronze.note_zh: 主要由铜和锡熔合而成的合金，古人常用它铸造钟和器皿。
bronze.note_en: An alloy made mainly from copper and tin, often used in ancient times to cast bells and vessels.

inscription.note_zh: 铸、刻或写在器物上的文字。
inscription.note_en: Words cast, carved, or written on an object.

marquis-yi-of-zeng.note_zh: 战国早期曾国的一位国君，他的墓中出土了著名的六十五口编钟。
marquis-yi-of-zeng.note_en: An early Warring States ruler of Zeng whose tomb held the famous set of sixty-five bells.

octave.note_zh: 音乐中从一个音到更高或更低的同名音之间的距离。
octave.note_en: The musical distance from one note to the next higher or lower note with the same name.

pitch.note_zh: 声音听起来高或低的程度。
pitch.note_en: How high or low a sound seems.

replica.note_zh: 根据原物制作的仿制品，可以用于研究、展示或演奏。
replica.note_en: A carefully made copy of an original object, used for study, display, or performance.

vibration.note_zh: 物体快速来回运动；这种运动会推动空气，形成声音。
vibration.note_en: A rapid back-and-forth movement that can push the air and create sound.

wu-zhou.note_zh: 武则天称帝后建立的王朝，从公元690年延续到705年。
wu-zhou.note_en: The dynasty Wu Zetian established and ruled from 690 to 705.

zhou-dynasty.note_zh: 武则天以前一千多年的古代王朝，不是她建立的武周。
zhou-dynasty.note_en: An ancient dynasty from more than a thousand years before Wu Zetian, not the Wu Zhou dynasty she established.

zhan-guo-ce.note_zh: 汇集战国时期各国谋略、游说和政治故事的一部古书。
zhan-guo-ce.note_en: An ancient collection of political arguments, strategies, and stories from the Warring States period.
